body.name: gBump
body.def: \((g_{h,j})_{j=1}^{K_h}\) are translates and rescalings of one fixed nonzero nonnegative \(C^\infty\) bump supported strictly inside the unit cell, each bounded by one and supported inside \(B_{h,j}\). They have disjoint supports, satisfy \(\|\sum_j\omega_jg_{h,j}\|_{\mathcal H^\gamma}\le C_g h^{-\gamma}\) for \(\gamma\in\{\beta_e,\beta_m\}\), and obey \(\int_{\mathbb T^d}\sum_jg_{h,j}(x)^2\,dx=c_g\).
